threads.body: [General] This accepts instrumentation-scope samples without collecting their validation findings. Weaver 0.26.1 gives the scope its own `live_check_result` and also validates its attributes, so `checkCommonViolations()` can now pass while the omitted scope findings contain violations. Parse the scope and its attributes just as the other supported sample types are parsed.
why do we need to read the `instrumentation_scope` here ?

replies.body: Because the test fails with `throw new IllegalStateException("unexpected weaver validation result type");` since now there are instrumentationScope samples that are unexpected. You are welcome to come up with an alternative solution. Alternatively we can block weaver updates.
